shots.NOTE: pov of a runner in the tower shoving the sniper and the cinematic shot that plays after, in hell
shots.seen: 0.00-0.50: first-person view inside the red hell tower; a sniper stands under the arches ahead while the caption reads 'HERES HOW I / FIXED THE WORST'. 0.75: the runner's hands come up into frame to shove, but the sniper is already small and far off, so no contact shows. 1.00-2.25: cut to an overhead cinematic of the sniper ragdolling down over lava and the red void, ending upright at 2.25. Captions 'PART ABOUT / MY GAME'.
shots.why: The hell tower POV and the falling cinematic are both there, but the shove is one frame of hands with the sniper far away, so the hit itself is never seen.

shots.NOTE: runner pov, looking over at the tower while hes shooting, then look forward and start doing the lava parkour section
shots.seen: 2.50–7.00: a nearly fixed first-person view of a red stone tower wall with a dark round opening and a small arched window. Only small white specks change, and no shooter or clear shots can be seen. 7.25–8.50: the camera turns into the lava corridor and moves forward over lava platforms; lava parkour, with the runner's legs/feet visible at times and yellow tracer marks. 8.75: a circular wipe into the next shot ('BUT THIS HAS').
shots.why: The look at the tower is a near-static hold for about 4.5 s with no visible shooter, then the lava parkour starts correctly from the runner's eyes.

shots.NOTE: Shot of starting shove tower minigame in hell
shots.seen: 8.90–12.40: a circular scope view of a red hell arena. A few small distant runners stand near a dark pillar giving off orange sparks, captioned 'but this has a problem whos the sniper first I wanted it to be earned'. 12.65–23.40: hard cut to a dark green forest map. A third-person chase cam follows teal, purple and blue runners between large trees, captioned 'so I implemented a race every player does the course with no sniper and the first one to complete it gets to be the sniper this was the worst part of my game it wasnt fun everyone was the'.
shots.why: About 11 of the 14.6 s is a forest race rather than hell, and the hell part is only a distant scope view of a pillar, so no shove tower minigame start is visible.
